correctness.rationale: The stationary Markov generator gives the explicit exact two-state angular-moment recurrence with a strictly positive determinant for all degree-positive terms. Symbolic elimination exactly gives the rational fourth-cumulant numerator P(W)=AW²+BW−C and H>0. Because C>0, the elementary real-quadratic discriminant/root argument proves every sign and boundary, including the critical factorization B=(2g+3)(80g²−30g−141)/16. Independent time-ordered Markov resolvent integration agrees for 37 parameter triples; finite checks are not used as a substitute for the generator and polynomial proof. Additive independent thermal Gaussian noise has zero fourth cumulant.

value.rationale: Random sign reversals of angular velocity occur in a published model of swimming microorganisms; the physically motivated open question is how harmonic confinement filters its non-Gaussianity. The complete sign classification gives a universal sharp flip-to-trap rate boundary and a distinct two-reversal interval, while noise independence clarifies an observable effect robust to independent translational Gaussian fluctuations. It supplies an exact model-specific phase diagram, not a routine parameter substitution, and may benchmark future spectroscopy and stochastic-swimmer theory without claiming experimental validation.
